ownerOnly: Only the bot owner can update ARCHON.
checking: Checking GitHub for a newer version…
upToDate: You already have the latest version ({ver}). There is nothing to install.
restarting: ARCHON is moving from version {oldV} to {newV}. I'm restarting now, which takes about half a minute. I'll send you a message as soon as I'm back.
available:
Version {newV} is ready, and this server is on {oldV}.

Send {cmd} and I'll install it for you. If the new version doesn't start properly, I'll go back to the current one on my own.
back: I'm back online on version {ver}. The update worked.
rolledBack: The new version didn't start properly, so I went back to version {ver}. The bot is running normally again.
noNotes: No release notes were published for this version.
wrongBranch: This copy of the bot is on the branch "{branch}" instead of main, so I can't update it safely.
localChanges:
Some files on this server were changed by hand, and I won't overwrite your changes. Save or undo these first:
{list}
syntaxFail: The new version failed a safety check in {file}, so nothing was changed and you're still on the old version.
installFail: Installing the new packages failed, so I went back to the old version.
fetchFail: I couldn't reach GitHub. Please try again in a few minutes.
unknownFail: Something went wrong during the update. {why}
